summary: No more false "not refreshed" warning, exports read one consistent picture, and updates started by hand go through.

fixes.title: No false recommendations warning
fixes.text: The run report no longer says the Defender for Cloud recommendations were not refreshed when they were.

fixes.title: Partial results said as not complete
fixes.text: When a Defender for Cloud result was not read in full, the reports that use it say it is not complete, and nothing is closed because of it.

fixes.title: Consistent exports
fixes.text: Exports read one consistent picture while data changes; an export whose rows changed while it ran is refused, never handed out mixed.

fixes.title: Updates started by hand go through
fixes.text: An update started by hand close to a scheduled update time is no longer ended early.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The identity-names report is stored whole, support sees the last run per step and the image clean-up, and large exports continue on a second sheet.
